summary: Frontend regression for Teologia Viva PWA: validated desktop 1440x900 and mobile 412x915 layouts after the major refactor (2-col grid, always-mounted selection bar with 6 buttons, AITutorDrawer paddingBottom 120px, always-mounted mobile modals). 8/10 review items passed. ONE CRITICAL BUG FOUND: the floating selection-bar (and any other position:fixed inside <main>) is positioned relative to <main> instead of the viewport because Layout.jsx applies CSS `contain: layout paint` on <main>. Result: the selection-bar renders far below the viewport and is INVISIBLE to users on both desktop and mobile, even though programmatic clicks still reach it. 0 console errors, 0 insertBefore crashes.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: <main> in Layout.jsx has style={{ contain: 'layout paint' }}. CSS `contain: layout` makes <main> the containing block for any position:fixed descendant. The Biblia selection-bar (position:fixed; bottom:90px) is therefore positioned relative to <main> — its bounding rect was {y: 4421, bottom: 4577} on a 412x915 viewport (scrollY=0), i.e. ~3500px below the viewport. The bar is computed-visible (visibility:visible, zIndex 99999) but VISUALLY OFF-SCREEN. Same bug affects the floating bar on desktop. Reproduce: open /biblia, tap any verse → no toolbar appears at bottom of screen; programmatic click via testid still works.

The review request specified Tutor IA messages area should have paddingTop:70px on mobile, but on /aula/64 in 412x915 viewport the messages container reports paddingTop:16px (pb is correct at 120px). May only be correct in the always-mounted mobile branch which only renders when pointer:coarse media query matches (Playwright Chromium has fine pointer, so cannot fully validate the 70px branch automatically — main agent should verify on a real touch device or via Chrome DevTools device-mode).

action_items: HIGH PRIORITY — Remove `contain: 'layout paint'` from <main> in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx OR portal the selection-bar (and any other position:fixed children) to document.body. Without this, the floating Bíblia toolbar is invisible to all users. Verify by opening /biblia on desktop & mobile, tapping a verse — the bar must appear at viewport bottom (~bottom:88-90px from window).

Verify (and fix if needed) AITutorDrawer paddingTop on mobile — review request said 70px, code path appears guarded by pointer:coarse media query so Playwright cannot test it. Recommend manual check on Chrome DevTools mobile emulation with touch ON.

Consider switching the isMobile detection in Biblia.jsx (line 72-80) and AITutorDrawer.jsx from `pointer: coarse` to `(max-width: 1023px)` (or a combination) so QA tools and narrow-window desktops also exercise the mobile branch.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx line 50 sets `contain: layout paint` on <main>. This is the root cause of the position:fixed regression for any modal/bar mounted inside the page Outlet (selection-bar, off-screen image card, study-mobile-modal at zIndex 99998). The BottomNav escapes this because it is rendered outside <main>. Either remove `contain` or use a portal for fixed elements.

Biblia.jsx is now 1187 lines combining reader, selection-bar, two pickers, study sidebar, mobile modal and a hidden share-image card. Splitting into SelectionBar.jsx, StudyPanel.jsx, ShareCard.jsx is overdue and would simplify the recent fixed-positioning work.

isMobile detection via `window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)')` excludes a range of legitimate mobile contexts (touch-screen laptops show pointer:fine; desktop Chrome at narrow width never matches). Combining with viewport width is more robust and would also make automated QA reliable.

openTutorIA in Biblia.jsx uses the same Drawer as the study menu (`setDrawerOpen(true)`), it does NOT mount the AITutorDrawer component. The 6th 'selection-tutor-ia' button thus opens the Vaul Drawer with the AI block focused — the review request's 'AITutorDrawer opens' phrasing is technically inaccurate for /biblia; AITutorDrawer is only used on /aula/{id}.
The page-level data-testid coverage is excellent (all 6 selection buttons, sidebar items, aula sidebar items found by testid).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 confirms the layout refactor structure is correct (2-col grids, all 6 selection buttons present, correct testids in study sidebar, AulaNotes save button golden #C5A059 confirmed). The blocking issue is purely the CSS `contain: layout paint` on <main> which breaks position:fixed for the selection-bar (and any other fixed child of <main>). Fix that single line in Layout.jsx and re-test. The mobile-only modal branches (study-mobile-modal and ai-tutor-mobile-modal) cannot be triggered in default Playwright Chromium because they are gated by pointer:coarse — main agent should either change the gating to viewport-based or test manually with DevTools touch emulation. No console errors / no insertBefore crashes observed during the entire run.
rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx line 49-51 — `<main className="flex-1 px-5 py-5 lg:px-8 lg:py-8" style={{ contain: 'layout paint' }}>`. The CSS `contain: layout` (and `paint`) creates a new containing block for fixed-positioned descendants per the W3C CSS Containment spec. Therefore the Biblia selection-bar (rendered as a child of <main> via the Outlet, with `position:fixed; bottom:90px`) is positioned relative to <main>'s box — not the viewport. Confirmed at runtime: bar.offsetParent === MAIN; getBoundingClientRect = {y:4421, bottom:4577} on a 412x915 viewport with scrollY=0 (so the bar lives ~3500px below the visible area). Mitigation: (a) drop the `contain` declaration on <main>, OR (b) move the selection-bar (and other fixed overlays) to a React portal mounted at document.body, OR (c) move the selection-bar render to be a sibling of <main>/<BottomNav> directly under the outer wrapper.
